workerResult.summary: Baseline Bazaar — sci-fi-terminal kinetic type tank. Type phrases to drop variable-font word bodies with gravity/bounce physics, pairwise elastic collisions, mouse repel/drag-throw/click-blast, 4 arrange modes (CHAOS/GRID/ORBIT/RAIN), weight/width/size/gravity/bounce sliders, boot log + HUD, localStorage persistence, PNG snap and self-contained LZW GIF89a loop export (24f/12fps/2s, verified decoding all frames in PIL with pixel-exact palette). 3 inks + black/white, responsive to 375px.
